description: Get one code's full details and scan stats: what list_codes shows, a contact card's fields, and for changeable codes the scans in the last 7, 30, 90 or 365 days (unique visitors, scans per day, countries, devices) and its last 10 changes, such as where it pointed before and pauses. Static codes have no stats: they can't be counted. Automated checks (link previews, bots) are left out of the numbers, and days are in UTC. Find the code with list_codes first if you don't know its id or link ending. Read only; works with any key.

code.description: The code: its id from list_codes, or a changeable code's link ending (e.g. "menu" for makemyqrcodes.com/menu)

days.description: Stats period in days: 7, 30, 90 or 365. Default 30

name: get_code

contact.description: Contact cards: the card's fields (first, last, org, phone, email...)

folder.description: Left out when the code isn't in a folder

holds.description: Where it points, or what it holds, in a few words

id.description: Use it as "code" in get_code, update_code and download_code

last_scan_at.description: ISO time of the latest scan

link.description: Changeable codes: the short link the printed code holds

locked.description: true when a lapsed plan locks editing; the code still works

scans.description: Changeable codes: scans of all time, automated checks left out

device.description: ios, android, windows, mac, linux or other

unique_visitors.description: Counted per day: one person on two days counts twice

title: Code details and scans
